name: Crimson Terror grants Transgression 50% Spirit spell damage (#937)
contract: Crimson Terror 560073 effect 1 carries ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), BasePoints 49 (real value 50, EffectDieSides=1), classmask (0,0,4) which matches exactly one family-26 spell: 801102 'Transgression' (a hidden buff). SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp) unconditionally applies SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 to effect index 0 of the matched spell via Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers; 801102's own effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_STAT_PERCENT (aura 174) against Spirit, with a baseline BasePoints of -1 (real value 0). spell_effect_value reads this live, modified value without requiring the player to hold Transgression as an aura.

steps.label: Transgression grants no Spirit spell damage before Crimson Terror
Crimson Terror raises Transgression's Spirit coefficient to 50%
